participant_1.name: Jake
participant_1.personality: Cynical but yearning for connection, Jake often feels isolated and struggles with the consequences of his past choices.
participant_1.background: I like to spend my money on cars. I have never had a steady relationship. I watch too much TV in my spare time. I go to the gym most days just to socialize. I work from home.

participant_2.name: Lila
participant_2.personality: Lila is a resilient young woman facing her challenges with a hint of optimism, despite her current situation in detention.
participant_2.background: I'm here for shoplifting. I feel old. I'm currently in a juvenile detention center. I will be released in about a month. My mom is coming to visit me tomorrow.
